BiblicalUsage: Kalal means to complete or perfect — here, the builders of Tyre perfecting her beauty. Her borders were in the midst of the seas, and her builders made her beauty perfect, a ship fitted out like a city.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Tyre's perfected beauty is a warning: men can finish a thing beautifully and still see it sink, because no beauty survives that is built without God.
